title.narrative: Output A.1. Enhanced decent work statistics using innovative sources and statistical standards

description.narrative: From October 2022, Uganda Bureau of Statistics (UBOs) produced and disseminated National Labour Force Survey (NLFS) Report. Thematic/modular report on informality, child labour and youth analysed, produced and published and disseminated Population and Housing Census pilot conducted using 19th ICLS Resolution With the resources from the EU funded project on Enhanced Impact of Public Financial Management on National and Sub-national Employment Governance (UGA/20/01/EUR), the ILO provided support to Uganda National statistical office; Uganda Bureau of Statistics (UBOS) to analyse the National Labour Forces Survey (NLFS), quality assure, published and disseminated LFS reports in Nov 2022 using the latest (International Conference of Labour Statisticians (ICLS) standards which is 20th ICLS Resolution on work relationships. Population and Housing Census questionnaire was piloted using the ILO model questionnaire for Census which incorporates the 19th ICLS Resolution on work, employment and labour underutilization.

description.narrative: National Employment Strategy with a focus on youth, developed in consultation with social partners adopted, including the clarification of functions, responsibilities, M&E framework and medium-term funding requirements for sub-national employment governance The ILO used resources availed under the European Commission funded project on Enhanced Impact of Public Financial Management on National and Sub-national Employment Governance (UGA/20/01/EUR) to support development of Uganda National employment strategy through a consultative process, technical trainings, and workshops, along with technical backstopping form the ILO relevant technical units in the Decent Work Team, Pretoria and Headquarters. The strategy was earmarked for approval by the National employment council in September 2022
